description: This file defines the Event model class for the Opencart admin setting module, providing methods to add, delete, update, and retrieve event records from the database.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Model class for managing event records in the Opencart admin setting module.

methods.name: addEvent
methods.description: Creates a new event record in the database and returns its primary key.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes an event record by its primary key.

methods.name: deleteEventByCode
methods.description: Deletes an event record by its code.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of an event by its primary key.

methods.name: editStatusByCode
methods.description: Updates the status of an event by its code.

methods.name: getEvent
methods.description: Retrieves an event record by its primary key.

methods.name: getEventByCode
methods.description: Retrieves an event record by its code.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Retrieves a list of event records based on filters.

methods.name: getTotalEvents
methods.description: Returns the total count of event records matching filters.
